title: Coached trainers so teams could lead their own AI adoption
summary: With Philips University, I ran a train-the-trainer class for 34 people; the Bangalore team that took it went on to lead its own AI work and use it to speed up releases.
what_would_have_happened: AI adoption would depend on me teaching every team myself.
the_call: Coach people inside the team so they can teach the rest.
what_i_did: Ran the class with Philips University and backed the team member who took on the champion role.
what_changed: The team built an end-to-end AI use case, from knowledge transfer to test cases, and a senior leader publicly praised its results.

quotes.text: Our team in Bangalore is doing some great things with the application of AI to accelerate their software releases.
